description: This JSON file defines the schema and API interface for the VoiceControl plugin, including methods, events, and data structures related to managing voice control sessions within a software project.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures the RDK's voice stack with URLs, enable flags, and specific device settings such as PTT, FF, and MIC.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the Voice Server, including message type, session ID, timestamp, and payload.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Sets application metadata in the INIT message sent to the Voice Server, including capabilities and language.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Simulates a voice session using a transcription string for QA purposes, triggering session events.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves supported voice session request types and status.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Requests a voice session with specific parameters such as transcription, audio file, application name, and request type.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates a specific voice session identified by session ID.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts an additional audio stream for a specific voice session.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Returns current configuration and status details of the RDK voice stack, including URLs and device statuses.
